notes.title: VolleyBrawl - Demo - Steam Summer Event Festival
notes.content:
The game and the demo are two different versions of VolleyBrawl. 

The demo was created for the sole purpose of joining the Steam Summer Event Festival. It is there to give you a hint of what the game is but in no way is it exactly the same with the game.

The demo
No ONLINE features. Online mode is taken out. Steam Remote Play will still work but you need to do that outside of the game.

The game
1. Creating a lobby.
2. Joining a lobby. 
3. Joining public matches using quick search or matches between friends only.
4. Leaving matches. But we warned leaving a public match will be considered as abandoning a match. Abandoning matches will prevent players using online features for a period of time.
5. Inviting friends or recently played with players to your lobby.
6. Remote play in game invitation.
7. Voice chat, uses push to talk and includes muting. 
8. Achievements (Most can only be achieved through online matches)
9. Stats, like how many times you have won using a certain robot. Global stats to see what is trending.

The demo
1. Can select from 2 robots.
2. Can only have a maximum of 2 players.

The game
1. Can play all 6 robots.
2. Can have a maximum of 6 players.

The demo
Robot stats are okay. 100% need improvements.

The Game
Robot stats will be constantly tweaked to maintain a good, fun, balanced game.

The demo
Is already outdated with some noticeable bugs. But they are more UI related bugs than game bugs. There are game bugs but they are not game stoppers.

The game
Always being updated and adding more features.

:::WARNING:::
This game is NOT for casual gamers. VolleyBrawl requires experienced hand eye coordination, and fast reflexes.

When you run the game, you will first go through the tutorial. This will teach you some of the controls that you need to play the game. You can skip the tutorial anytime you want but I highly recommend going through it at least once.

After the tutorial, you will go back to the main menu and from there select play, select your robot, and have fun.

notes.title: Alpha to Beta
notes.content:
After 8 months of hard work into the game, VolleyBrawl is now finally able to reach beta stage.

Top 10 big features that is has right now:
1. Core Game Play
2. Online Multiplayer
3. Online Lobby System
4. Steam Input Controls (Tested on different controllers - Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, Generic)
5. Steam Remote Play (Remote TV, Remote Phone and Tablet)
6. Steam Voice Chat
7. Stats and Achievements
8. Awesome 3D and 2D audio feedback and background music
9. Tutorial System
10. AI teammates and opponents

At this point it is more about testing and polishing. One big issue that is happening with the game right now is random lagging with online matches. It may be a server issue as it doesn't happen all the time. I will try my best to deliver a game where online matches don't suddenly have rubber-banding effect going on.
